payload.title: Authorized pending Reference intake for editorial user sessions
payload.description: As an authenticated publication editor, I want pending source intake and provenance through the supported API so reporting can attach sources without generic knowledge-model writes. Existing Google-auth CLI catalog intake fails remotely: Not Authorized to access updateKnowledgeCorpus on type Mutation. Scope: validated publication and actor, canonical URL deduplication, idempotent pending References/provenance, supported CLI path; generic models remain read-only. No publication, labels, new credentials, unrelated releases, or IAM authoring fallback. Done: executable authorization/isolation/repeat/linking specs pass, reviewable PR and deployment permissions documented, existing TI DeepSeek story live acceptance verified only after deployed route is available.
